question: Under the Government of India Act, 1919, which subjects were transferred to Indian ministers?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Education and Health**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Under the **Government of India Act, 1919**, the concept of **Dyarchy** was introduced in the provinces. It divided the provincial subjects into two categories: **Reserved** and **Transferred**.
